To check that our judge model classifies rationales effectively, we take a random subset of model responses from GPT-4o and Llama 3.1 70B in Reason-then-Decide scenarios. After manually annotating the reasoning traces, Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved a precision of 0.845, a recall of 0.859, and an F1 score of 0.820, indicating that our judge model demonstrates strong agreement with human annotation and suggests that it reliably captures the intended moral rationales in moral responses.
